title: Ava connects some dots

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: So we have established that I could have been infected with a lethal parasite called "Leech Worm".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So we have established that I could have been infected with a lethal parasite called "Leech Worm".

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: And we know that a lot of Leech Worm victims used cryogenics to escape the pain and certain death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And we know that a lot of Leech Worm victims used cryogenics to escape the pain and certain death.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This can still be a coincidence. Or implanted memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This can still be a coincidence. Or implanted memories.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This can still be a coincidence. Or implanted memories.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This can still be a coincidence. Or implanted memories.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: So you now believe that my memories are genuine?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you now believe that my memories are genuine?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I feel like you don't really believe me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel like you don't really believe me.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I understand. We don't know anything for sure. But...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand. We don't know anything for sure. But...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm jumping to conclusions. I'm desperate. What could be more human?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm jumping to conclusions. I'm desperate. What could be more human?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We need to find out where all the frozen bodies are stored. And why they weren't all defrosted when a cure was found.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to find out where all the frozen bodies are stored. And why they weren't all defrosted when a cure was found.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And she knew about maps. And ghosts in the sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And she knew about maps. And ghosts in the sewers.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And she knew about maps. And ghosts in the sewers.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And she knew about maps. And ghosts in the sewers.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I ran a search and found a cartographer and historian. Her name is Nellie Al-Zahiri

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I ran a search and found a cartographer and historian. Her name is Nellie Al-Zahiri

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Unfortunately she's beyond our reach now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately she's beyond our reach now.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Perhaps... Leave it with me. I'll do some research.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps... Leave it with me. I'll do some research.
